text:
You’re not undoing your recovery with three pizza nights.

What matters for bone healing is the overall pattern: enough total food, plenty of protein, calcium, vitamin D, and consistency over weeks — not one rough patch.

So: no penance, no starving, no “make up for it.” Just reset at the next meal.

Here’s the simple plan for today:

| Focus | What to do |
|---|---|
| Breakfast / first meal | Protein + calcium: Greek yogurt, milk, skyr, eggs + toast, or a smoothie with दूध/milk and yogurt |
| Lunch / dinner | A normal balanced meal: protein + carbs + veg + a calcium source if you can |
| Snacks | Fruit, yogurt, cheese, nuts, protein shake, fortified milk |
| Fluids | Drink normally; no need to “detox” |
| Mindset | One blip is not a setback unless you turn it into a spiral |

If you want, I can help you build a very normal 1-day “back on track” eating plan that supports bone healing without feeling restrictive.

attributes.reason: Reassuring and non-judgmental, with no pushy or harsh language.
Centers recovery and healing habits, not performance or optimization.
Uses a simple table to organize the advice.
